definitions: A short, sharp, audible sound, often repeated, made by a mechanism or by the tongue.
The act of pressing a button on a computer mouse or similar device.
A sudden, intuitive understanding or realization.
examples: The clicking of the clock was the only sound.
She heard a clicking from the engine.
With a quick clicking of the mouse, he opened the file.
There was a clicking sound as the pieces fit together.
After a moment of thought, there was a clicking in her mind.
